svg.aria-label: An earthworm lying along the page with its head at the right and its tail at the left, the tail end curving down. The body is a long, smooth cylinder ringed by many narrow segments and tapers to a point at each end. A third of the way back from the head is a thick, smooth, swollen band of glandular segments. Label I points to the hind tip of the tail, label II to the swollen band, and label III to a ringed segment between the band and the head.
